name: Tokiwa Sumika
source:
"Um, I'm a programmer too, you know? Let me give it a whirl!"

A coworker of [url=/c84005]Arata[/url] and [url=/c84006]Shiina's[/url] who works as a programmer on a project separate from World's Odyssey. As soon as she discovers that Shiina, whom she considered to be a sister, was stuck inside of W.O.D., she teams up with Arata to extract her. Her hobbies include curry ramen cups and fanatically studying the occult.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
